description: This file defines the UsernamePasswordCredentials class, which represents user authentication credentials consisting of a username and password in the OpenMRS core API.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordCredentials
classes.description: A class that encapsulates user credentials with username and password for authentication within OpenMRS.

methods.name: UsernamePasswordCredentials
methods.description: Constructor that initializes username and password fields.

methods.name: getAuthenticationScheme
methods.description: Returns the authentication scheme identifier used for this credential type.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the username part of the credentials.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the password part of the credentials.

methods.name: getClientName
methods.description: Returns the username as the client name for identification purposes.
